purpose: A loading indicator on its own, beside a label or covering content, with a delay before it appears and a minimum time on screen.

supplied: the spinner graphic is aria-hidden and the label carries the announcement
a delay before appearing, so fast work never flashes a spinner
a minimum duration once shown, so it does not flicker out instantly
required: a `label` saying what is loading, or `showLabel` where it should be visible too
use Progress instead when the length is known

composition.notes: Covering content is a variant of this component rather than a separate overlay.

safeMutations.rationale: Everything here is presentation except whether the work is happening.

propNotes.delay: Nothing renders before this elapses, which is what stops a spinner flashing on fast connections.
